# Loona Design Studio

> Free online design tools by Loona Automation. Every tool runs 100% in the visitor's browser: no sign-up, no uploads, no watermarks.

## Tools

- [Chart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/chart-maker/): Turn a table or pasted CSV into bar, line, pie and doughnut charts — custom colours, legend and PNG export.
- [Photo Collage Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/photo-collage-maker/): Combine 2–9 photos into polished grid, hero and mosaic collages with gaps, rounded corners and PNG/JPG export.
- [Logo Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/logo-maker/): Design a clean logo with your brand name, tagline, fonts, colour schemes and built-in icons — transparent PNG export.
- [Poster / Flyer Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/poster-maker/): Build posters and flyers on ready sizes (A4, square, story) with movable text and shapes, templates and PNG export.
- [Mind Map Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/mind-map-maker/): Grow ideas from a central node with tidy auto-layout, colour themes, pan and zoom — export PNG or save as JSON.
- [Drawing Whiteboard](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/drawing-whiteboard/): Sketch, annotate and brainstorm with pen, shapes and eraser — undo/redo and PNG export, touch friendly.
- [Flowchart Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/flowchart-maker/): Build flowcharts with process, decision, start/end and document shapes, smart connectors and PNG export.
- [Business Card Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/business-card-maker/): Design a print-ready business card (3.5 × 2 in at 300 DPI) with your details, colours and logo icon — PNG export.
- [Screenshot Beautifier](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/screenshot-beautifier/): Drop a screenshot onto a beautiful gradient backdrop with padding, rounded corners and shadow — share-ready PNG.
- [Image Annotation Editor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/image-annotation-editor/): Mark up screenshots and images with arrows, text labels, boxes and privacy blur — then export a clean PNG.
- [Favicon Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-design-studio/favicon-generator/): Turn a letter, emoji or initials into a full favicon set — PNG sizes plus a real .ICO file, generated on your device.
